title: Brass band experience and parades with Kid Rene
summary: He played in pickup brass bands, never regularly in the old bands, and doesn't recall playing brass band with Kid Rene.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I was going to ask, did you ever play in any brass bands very much in the old days, say back, when you first learned your horn, when did you start playing in brass bands?

Yes, I played in, uh, quite a few brass bands, uh, well, there weren't no, I would say organized bands, you know, a fellow would get a job or something and make up a brass band. Yeah, make up a group. Yes, but, uh, to say organized, because I can't swear that I ever played with the Eureka, which, yes, I did play with them, but that was later years. You talking about a long time. Yeah, way back then, the other older bands. No, I played, I played parades, yes, but I don't remember playing with none of those, no, regular, uh, brass bands. Because I heard they had, like, the hornwood, and they had, uh, maple, maple leaf, you know, was that a brass band or a jazz band? Maple leaf.
I seem to remember seeing that on the drum, a maple leaf band. Yeah.
Is that maple or silver leaf, let me think? Silver leaf, what do you mean? The one that, um, Mosley has. Yeah, it might have been silver leaf.
No, I can't, but I. Did you ever play with Kid René in a brass band? Did he ever have his own brass band?
I don't remember. No, I don't remember playing with Kid René in a brass band, no.
